integrity: All proof steps are symbolic. The focal full text and the closest classical N-supercyclicity papers were compared at statement/implication level. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the explicit coordinate-replication isometric copy from the focal source. It does not classify all operators failing finite supercyclicity, prove maximal lineability, or address Feldman infinite-supercyclicity. The originality claim is limited to the simultaneous all-finite-N isometric-copy strengthening and its infinite-codimensional range proof.
title: One isometric copy of \(\ell_p\) avoids every finite supercyclicity level
